1 lands belonging to Anakalamma Devastanam, Ankulapaturu Village, Chillakur Mandal, Tirupati District, is required for acquisition for a public purpose.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties.
Learned counsel representing the Temple has no objection for the acquisition of the subject endowment properties by the National Highways Authority.

We therefore permit the acquisition of the subject lands and direct that the compensation be paid in regard to the lands so acquired which should not be less than the compensation which may be fixed in the Award which might be passed in regard to the land which is sought to be acquired from other private parties, and in case, the landholders whose land has been acquired are not satisfied with the compensation awarded as per the Award and prefer an appeal, then the benefit of the enhancement of the compensation should also be given to the temples in regard to the subject land on the basis that the land which is sought to be acquired by the parties is in close proximity to the land belonging to the temples.

It shall also be open to the temple authorities or any devotee on behalf of the temples, to independently prefer an appeal seeking higher compensation in appeal proceedings under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
